title: Voice Input
subtitle: Local transcription stays on this device and does not upload audio; realtime voice calls use a separate cloud configuration.

sections.basicDescription: Recognition runs on this device. Recordings and transcription audio are not uploaded.

enabled.label: Show voice button in the input
enabled.description: Use the microphone to enter text in the conversation input.

language.label: Recognition language
language.description: Automatic by default; choose a language only when detection is inaccurate.

voiceCall.title: Realtime voice call
voiceCall.description: When enabled, microphone audio is sent from this controller to Volcengine for realtime processing. This is separate from local transcription.

enabled.label: Enable the client voice assistant
enabled.description: Talk to Volcengine's end-to-end realtime voice model from the bottom-right client launcher, let it understand workspace state, and start OpenBitFun tasks.

apiKey.label: Volcengine API key
apiKey.description: Used only by this controller for the voice connection; it is not sent to a remote workspace or peer device with a task.
apiKey.placeholder: Enter the end-to-end realtime voice API key

voice.label: Voice ID
voice.description: Uses the Jupiter female voice from the official demo by default.

status.label: Connection setup
status.description: Saving stores this configuration without verifying the API key or connection. Then open Hello at the bottom-right of the client and switch from text chat to realtime voice.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load controller realtime voice settings
messages.saveFailed: Failed to save realtime voice settings
messages.required: Enter an API key and voice before enabling realtime voice.
messages.unsaved: You have unsaved realtime voice changes.

call.title: Live Call

call.configureFirst: Configure a Volcengine realtime voice API key first.

call.taskAlreadyComplete: The task already finished, so there is nothing to stop.
call.noActiveTask: There is no OpenBitFun task running right now.

taskOutcome.completedWithoutConclusion: The task is complete, but it returned no written conclusion.

taskOutcome.cancelled: The task is incomplete because it was stopped as requested.

status.disconnected: The realtime voice connection was interrupted
status.audioPlaybackFailed: Voice playback failed. Check the system audio output.

taskPhases.working: OpenBitFun is still working on the task. I will keep following it.
taskPhases.using_tools: OpenBitFun is using tools to move the task forward.
taskPhases.waiting_approval: The task is waiting for your approval in OpenBitFun.
taskPhases.needs_input: OpenBitFun needs more information in the task session.
taskPhases.finishing: The main work is done and OpenBitFun is preparing the final result.

call.historySaveFailed: Voice history could not be saved. The transcript is retained for retry.

microphone.label: Input device
microphone.description: Uses the system default unless you choose a device for this computer.

recognition.label: Test voice input
recognition.description: Say a short phrase to check the microphone and local recognition together.

ready.title: Voice input is ready
ready.description: {{model}} processes speech on this device. Audio is not uploaded.

setup.title: Voice model not downloaded
setup.description: Download it to use voice input. It uses about {{size}}.
setup.summary: Voice model <warning>not downloaded</warning> — download it to use voice input.

downloading.title: Downloading voice model
downloading.description: Voice input will be available when {{model}} finishes downloading.

verifying.title: Verifying voice model
verifying.description: Checking that {{model}} is complete and ready to use.

unavailable.title: Cloud voice input is unavailable
unavailable.description: Your cloud configuration is preserved. Switch to local recognition to use voice input.

error.title: Voice model unavailable
error.description: {{model}} cannot be used. Review it and download it again.

localModels.title: Local voice models
localModels.description: Choose the model this device uses for speech recognition.
